visualCharacteristics.structure: background image + h1 + positioned logo markers

contentPattern: Row 1 (1 cell): map image (picture) + h1 'Contact Us'. Rows 2..14 (3 cells each): [country code text e.g. 'CA'] | [company logo picture + flag picture] | [link to affiliate site, link text = company name or code; '#' allowed for current site]. Marker position is driven by CSS keyed on the country code (decorator adds a class per marker), so authors never enter coordinates. Common red pin image is a block asset, not authored.
